paite: Diktatna thu dai dide in maw na gen taktak uh! Mihing tate aw, diktak in maw vai na hawm uh!
heading: David La / Pathian In Migilou Agawtna Dia Thumna

paite: Ahi, na lungtang uah thil thulim lou na hih nak ua; leitung ah na khut ua thil ngongtatna na bukkhia uhi.
Migilou-saloute anu uh gilsung a kipan in Pathian a pan khen in a-om ua; apiantak un zuauthu gen in avakmang zel uhi.
Agu uh gulgu bang ahi a; thangtom nangong abil hum bang ahi uhi.
Huai in gul aitawi aw angaikhe kei a, bangchibang a siam in bum mah le uh.
Pathian aw, akam uah hate tansak inla; TOUPA aw, humpinelkai hatsanlaite ha lian pipite tongkhia in.
Amau tui hattak a luang bang in tuimang uhenla; athalte a angim in, sattan bang in om zel hen.
Dokdawn, tui a mang maimah zel bang hileh; ahun lou a numei nau neih, nisa mel mu lou bang hi hen aw.
Na belte un ling satna atheih ma un leng ama'n pingpei in alamang ding; ahing lai leh akuang lai leng.
Midiktat in phulakna amuh in akipak ding a, migilou-salou sisan ah akhe asil ding hi.
Huchi in mite'n, "Midiktat a ding in kipahman a-om taktak a, lei ah vaihawmpa Pathian a-om taktak hi," achi ding uhi.
